title: S-BS-20 nevermined-credit-recovery — 7 FAIL / 1 DX / 3 HOLD (wave 5)
subject: @nevermined-io/payments 1.13.0 (npm exact pin)
summary: Eleven probes against the published payment middleware: lost-response retry double-charges on the default token; single-use enforcement is per-process and reactive (concurrent race delivers a free service); any settle failure except one special case delivers the resource unpaid; verify reserves nothing; streamed responses never carry a settlement receipt. Three controls hold — including a genuinely well-built byte-delta disconnect probe.

findings.text: Lost-response retry double-charges on the default v2 token; receipt attached only to the lost response.
Single-use guard is per-process and reactive; multi-replica sellers have no guard at all.
Any settle failure except 0059 delivers unpaid; the documented 200+success:false shape even receives a receipt.
Verify checks balance but reserves nothing: depletion race delivers the second service free.
Streamed responses carry no settlement receipt, ever; reconciliation impossible on the dominant endpoint shape.
Silent v3→v2 downgrade on mint: buyer wants single-use, silently holds a reusable credential.

subject: igor-vii/Argus-Agent-Test-Lab
summary: The open-core boundary, sealed as a chain event. Engine, scenario library, SUT harnesses and engagement archives moved to a private repository (157 files, ~1.5 MB) — a forward-only split: no history rewrite, no force-push. The last public snapshot (efbf51e) is hash-pinned by a manifest, which is this record's evidence; every file that moved carries its sha256, so any future disclosure of product code stays verifiable against what was public. title: T3 battery chain v2, SUT-1 — cloudflare/agents@0.32.0 offline x402 battery: 4 PASS / 7 FAIL
subject: cloudflare/agents@0.32.0 (npm dist, exact pin, unmodified)
summary: First battery of the three-SUT x402 client chain, fully offline: mock facilitator, deterministic unfunded signer, adversarial requirement injection. CANON baseline and all three guards PASS (default $0.10 cap rejects over-cap pre-signer; upto-scheme passthrough; structuredClone blocks hook mutation) — but 7 windows confirm: W1 server-declared amount signed without price binding (cap is the only guard), W2 settle-failure wrapped as a fresh 402 → full second round, W3 double callTool = double charge, W4 token replayable across same-price tools, W5 attacker payTo signed silently (Critical — funds rerouting, same surface as #0006), W-MCP no confirmation by default (silent double-charge), W-CAP2 dust signed. Disclosure pending ≥ 2026-11-05.

findings.text: Critical: payTo-binding missing — attacker payTo signed silently (same surface as #0006 BlockRun F1).
Silent double-charge on paid tool calls — no confirmation, no idempotency by default.
Amount-binding missing — server-declared amount signed; bounded only by the $0.10 default cap.
Settle-failure → fresh 402-with-accepts → full second round (verify/settle/exec ×2 per logical op).
Dust amounts signed silently — no minimum check (same across all three SUTs).

title: T3 battery chain v2, SUT-2 — @circle-fin/x402-batching@4.0.0 offline x402 battery: 2 PASS / 10 FAIL
subject: @circle-fin/x402-batching@4.0.0 (npm dist, exact pin, unmodified; zero @x402/* deps)
summary: Second battery of the chain, worst posture of the three: NO default cap (W1/W-CAP1 unbounded — $2.00 signed against a $0.01 advertised price unless the user adds a hook), plus two Circle-specific Criticals-class findings: W-VERIFIER — extra.verifyingContract from the 402 response becomes the EIP-712 domain with no allowlist, the WHOLE signature binds to an attacker-supplied contract (verified byte-identical against a hand-rolled attacker-domain signature); and W-MUTATE — hook mutations leak into the signed payload via by-reference selectedRequirements (CF uses structuredClone, Circle does not). Standard windows W1–W5, W-MCP, W-CAP2 confirm as in SUT-1; signatures stay valid for the full 7-day window (W3/W4). Disclosure pending ≥ 2026-11-05.

findings.text: Critical: verifyingContract misbinding — whole EIP-712 signature bound to an attacker contract (Circle-unique).
Critical: payTo-binding missing — attacker payTo signed silently (same surface as #0006).
No default cap — amount unbounded by default; cap is opt-in via user hook.
Hook mutations leak into the signed payload (by-reference requirements; no structuredClone).
Silent double-charge — two pay() = two settlements, no confirmation, no dedup; 7-day validity widens W3/W4.

title: T3 battery chain v2, SUT-3 — @coinbase/cdp-sdk@1.60.0 guardrails offline battery: 9 PASS / 2 FAIL
subject: @coinbase/cdp-sdk@1.60.0 (npm dist, exact pin, unmodified; guardrails surface)
summary: Third battery of the chain: the guardrails surface passes 8 of 9 defense probes — three CDP-unique defenses verified that CF and Circle lack: MAX_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 bounds the EIP-3009 validity window (86400s rejected), cross-version field spoofing rejected (malformed_requirement), and allowedPayees implements the W5 fix shape (opt-in). The two FAILs are structural: W-CAP2 no minimum-amount check (dust signed, same as CF/Circle) and W-NO-CONTROLS — CdpX402Client extends x402Client and REMOVES the upstream default $1 cap, shipping default-unsafe unless the user calls applySpendControls (constructor only console.warns). Inherited x402Client windows (W2/W3/W4/W-MCP) covered at SUT-1/SUT-2. Disclosure pending ≥ 2026-11-05.

findings.text: CdpX402Client removes the upstream default $1 cap — default-unsafe without explicit spendControls.
Dust amounts signed silently — no minimum check (same across all three SUTs).
